intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Someone has handed you a cup of tea. Before you can drink it, Senna leans over and breathes in the steam.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She breathes in again, longer, with her eyes shut.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Stewed. Four sugars. Whoever made this hates teeth.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Drink it if you like. It’s only bad.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “I know every teapot at this court by smell. Nobody’s ever poured me one.”

options.labelText: “Thanks, but I like my tea the way it comes.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She hands it back. You drink it. Four sugars is a lot of sugars.

options.labelText: “Want your own? I’ll pour. Smell it for as long as you like.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You pour her a cup. She breathes it in for a long time before she drinks.
